findings.title: Pages 11 and 317 disagree
findings.message: Inconsistency flagged, verify.

quotes.text: requires forest clearance for diversion of 0.748 ha under the Van (Sanrakshan Evam Samvardhan) Adhiniyam, 1980

Forest Clearance – Scrutiny of the forest clearance proposal for road ID 4817 involving 1.02 hectares of forest land diversion, recommendation to state government for the clearance, providing stage-1 clearance and provide report on compliance with the conditions to the State Government/ MoEFCC, Implementation Monitoring and Reporting, to assist in the process of providing stage-2 forest clearance.

evidence.label: Checked by
evidence.value: Nemotron Ultra, reading both full pages; 4 possible explanation words searched

findings.why: Page 11 states 0.748 ha of forest land diversion for Road ID 4817, while page 317 states 1.02 hectares for the same road. The report does not explain the discrepancy.
findings.clear: A statement in the report that the two passages cover different areas, dates or scopes, or a correction of one of them.

findings.title: Pages 136 and 286 disagree
findings.message: Inconsistency flagged, verify.

quotes.text: Out of the 1335 project roads, 547 roads are reported to have surface water body within 500m.
Approximately 500 roads not only has surface water bodies within 2 km of the roads, streams or canals also crosses a number of project roads.

evidence.label: Checked by
evidence.value: Nemotron Ultra, reading both full pages; 4 possible explanation words searched

findings.why: The first statement reports 547 roads with surface water bodies within 500 m, while the second states approximately 500 roads have surface water bodies within 2 km; since the 500 m buffer is a subset of the 2 km buffer, the latter number should be at least 547, making the two figures incompatible.
findings.clear: A statement in the report that the two passages cover different areas, dates or scopes, or a correction of one of them.

findings.title: Pages 51 and 271 disagree
findings.message: Inconsistency flagged, verify.

quotes.text: The requirement of 0.748 hectares of additional forest land for one project road (4817) has been indicated in the data shared by KRRDA.
one road will require additional forest land amounting to ~1.02 hectares

evidence.label: Checked by
evidence.value: Nemotron Ultra, reading both full pages; 17 possible explanation words searched

findings.why: Both statements cite KRRDA data for additional forest land needed for project road 4817 but report different hectare figures (0.748 vs ~1.02) with no explanation in the provided text for the discrepancy.
findings.clear: A statement in the report that the two passages cover different areas, dates or scopes, or a correction of one of them.

findings.title: Pages 51 and 59 disagree
findings.message: Inconsistency flagged, verify.

quotes.text: one road will require additional forest land amounting to ~1.02 hectares
except for one road (4817) which requires ~0.748 ha of forest land

evidence.label: Checked by
evidence.value: Nemotron Ultra, reading both full pages; 15 possible explanation words searched

findings.why: The two statements give different figures (~1.02 ha vs ~0.748 ha) for the additional forest land required for road 4817, and the report does not explain the discrepancy.
findings.clear: A statement in the report that the two passages cover different areas, dates or scopes, or a correction of one of them.

findings.title: Pages 14 and 23 disagree
findings.message: Inconsistency flagged, verify.

quotes.text: 305 roads are located outside protected areas and eco-sensitive zones but fall within EAAAs identified as critical habitat
The remaining 420 roads are within EAAAs determined to be critical habitats but outside legally designated protected areas, forest lands, or eco-sensitive zones

evidence.label: Checked by
evidence.value: Nemotron Ultra, reading both full pages; 12 possible explanation words searched

findings.why: The two statements give different counts (305 vs 420) for the same residual category of roads within EAAAs but outside protected areas, forest lands, and eco-sensitive zones. Page 14 notes that 171 roads fall into multiple categories, which may affect the calculation, but the report does not explicitly reconcile the two figures.
findings.clear: A statement in the report that the two passages cover different areas, dates or scopes, or a correction of one of them.

findings.title: Pages 57 and 357 disagree
findings.message: Inconsistency flagged, verify.

quotes.text: except road ID 4817, where 1.02 hectares of forest land will be required.

evidence.label: Checked by
evidence.value: Nemotron Ultra, reading both full pages; 15 possible explanation words searched

findings.why: Both statements refer to forest land for Road ID 4817, but report different areas (0.748 ha diversion vs 1.02 ha required) without any explanation in the provided pages.
findings.clear: A statement in the report that the two passages cover different areas, dates or scopes, or a correction of one of them.

findings.title: Pages 263 and 329 disagree
findings.message: Inconsistency flagged, verify.

quotes.text: Noise Pollution (Regulation and Control) Rules, 2000 limits applicable to Silence Zones (50 dB(A) day; 40 dB(A) night).

evidence.label: Checked by
evidence.value: Nemotron Ultra, reading both full pages; 6 possible explanation words searched

findings.why: Both statements give a nighttime noise limit for Silence Zones but cite different values (50 dB(A) vs 40 dB(A)) without reconciling them.
findings.clear: A statement in the report that the two passages cover different areas, dates or scopes, or a correction of one of them.

findings.title: Pages 71 and 253 disagree
findings.message: Inconsistency flagged, verify.

quotes.text: Borrow materials such as soil, gravel, moorum, or laterite required for embankment, subgrade, and shoulders will be procured from approved borrow areas generally located within 2 km to 10 km of the Project alignment.
with borrow areas to be sourced within 200 m of the alignment wherever suitable material is available

evidence.label: Checked by
evidence.value: Nemotron Ultra, reading both full pages; 11 possible explanation words searched

findings.why: The first statement says borrow areas are generally 2-10 km from the alignment, while the second says they should be sourced within 200 m wherever suitable material is available, without clarifying how these two ranges relate.
findings.clear: A statement in the report that the two passages cover different areas, dates or scopes, or a correction of one of them.
